Detailed Description

Base class for all the tables.

With this class you can build tables for waveforms, envelopes, etc. It has not a sampling rate because it is not linked to the time. With this class you can generate many types of signals, including sum of sines, squared wave, Gaussian windows, Hamming windows, straight convex/concave line segments, etc. The table is incremental, ie it NOT clear the data between operations, so you should do if necessary.

void SignalTable::drawSegment ( long  x0,
double  y0,
long  x1,
double  y1,
double  alpha 
)

Draws a segment in the table.

It creates straight or convex/concave line segments (depending on the alpha angle) between the point (x0, y0) and the point (x1, y1). If alpha == 0 it draws stright line segments, ie. it performs linear interpolation. This parameters assumes always the same meaning in all the functions. The x coordinates ARE the location of the table, so they MUST be smaller the the table length.

double& SignalTable::operator[] ( long  x  )  const [inline]

Returns the x-th element of the table.

The actual element returned is the (x mod len)th. This modulus operation while slowing down the perfomance of the class, ensures that no out-of-bounds requests will be delivered to the array.
